title: S39 — Performance profiling: identify and optimize slow pipeline stages
desc: Current latency: 6.7-7.9s per image (subprocess wrapper), 1.9-2.4s in-process. Demo bar is 10s. Need headroom for new features. Method: (1) profile each pipeline stage (load, threshold, segment, match, post-process); (2) identify top 3 slowest stages; (3) optimize (vectorization, caching, algorithmic improvements); (4) target: reduce total latency by 30%.
